data.displayName: Origin Go Variable Ongoing  - New & Move Customers only

fees.description: A $27.15 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $27.15 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
A 0.27% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by VISA debit card.
A 0.33% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by Mastercard debit card.
A 0.65% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by VISA credit card.
A 0.67% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by Mastercard credit card.
$2.15 (incl GST) may apply for each paper bill.
A 0.64% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by American Express credit card.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.

gasContract.terms: Offer not available in all areas or properties connecting for first time. Residential customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.
gasContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. For increases, notice will be at least 10 business days prior, for decreases, the notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date

incentives.description: One credit per natural gas account. If this Origin Go Variable Ongoing natural gas plan is still active with the customer on 13 September 2026, $100 (Incl. GST) credit will be applied to the customer's natural gas account after that date. If the customer ends this Origin Go Variable Ongoing natural gas plan before that date, the customer will not receive any credit. Credit is not redeemable for cash.

eligibility.description: Offer only available to new residential natural gas customers, and existing customers moving to a new property
Credit will only be applied if you haven't received a credit in the previous 12 months

gasContract.additionalFeeInformation: You must pay us any charges your distributor imposes on us in relation to services performed by your distributor (or anyone else) at your supply address. For details on additional charges that may apply see www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges
